# CodeEditSourceEditor vendored for Foundry

Upstream: https://github.com/CodeEditApp/CodeEditSourceEditor

Snapshot: tag `0.15.2`, commit `424453d2232c9912933a3b5a1f3d3df669404ed0`.

The upstream MIT license is in `LICENSE.md`. This copy keeps the editor source in Foundry so local fixes can be reviewed and maintained here. Example app, repository metadata, and CI files were omitted. Its language and text-view dependencies point to sibling vendored snapshots, and its build-only SwiftLint plugin was removed.
